product: measured rest/odor observer + measured fly graph
authority: Álvarez-Salvado et al. eLife 7:e37815 Video 1 (ACV 10% pulse, green overlay); Male CNS v1.0 + FlyWire v630 residual hops
honesty: Harvard tethered-walk clips have no rest. This video does: pre-odor still frames vs a 10 s ACV pulse vs offset search. Rest is not a neuron class — odor off and motion below MAD+φ means no afferent seed. Olfactory hops do not reach vnc_motor; JO / vnc_sensory do. Dryad 10.5061/dryad.g27mq71 is 6.94 GB and was not downloaded; GitHub is LabVIEW/MATLAB, not CSV. GABA only where annotated. Not a trained pose net, not a trained RNN, not a thought.

rest.why: odor off, motion below MAD+φ; no afferent seed

pre_walk.why: wind always on; fly moving before odor

offset.why: odor off after pulse; local search is not a cell class

observer.note: Green overlay is the paper's odor marker. Motor is chamber frame-diff energy and the first moment of |Δ| (not a trained pose net; dark-blob largest-CC follows vignette). Rest is an observer state, not a neuron class.

rest.name: rest
rest.note: no afferent seed when odor is off and motion is below MAD+φ

male_cns.authority: Male CNS v1.0 Berg et al. Cell 2026; traced neurons only; GABA from consensus_nt; weights = measured synapse counts

offset.note: local search after the pulse; not a cell class

loop.honesty: Olfactory hops stay in the antennal lobe (il3LN6) and do not light vnc_motor. JO / vnc_sensory do. Frame-diff energy rises in the pulse and peaks at offset (search). Motion first-moment is further upwind during odor than rest. Do not claim the olfactory cascade is the walking command.
